Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring port districts to apply to the Washington state quality award.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the Washington state quality award; and addinga new section to chapter 53.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 53.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Starting no later than 2009, and at least once every threeyears thereafter, port districts located in a county of one million ormore residents shall apply to the Washington state quality award, orsimilar organization, for an independent assessment of its qualitymanagement, accountability, and performance system. The assessmentshall evaluate the effectiveness of all elements of its management,accountability, and performance system, including: Leadership,strategic planning, customer focus, analysis and information, employeeperformance management, and process improvement. The purpose of theassessment is to recognize best practice and identify improvementopportunities. (2) The application, assessment, and action plan must be posted on p. 1 HB 3036the port district's web site. The action plan must include how eachimprovement opportunity will be accomplished.
